ex.en: His rude remarks provoked an angry response from the audience.
ex.zh: 他粗鲁的言论激起了听众的愤怒回应。

words.note: provoke 多接 reaction、anger，指主动激起反应。

ex.en: Rising sea levels threaten to flood many coastal cities.
ex.zh: 海平面上升预示许多沿海城市可能被淹。

words.note: threaten 后接不定式表示“预示可能发生”，接 with 表示以某物相要挟。

ex.en: Reading widely can enrich your life and broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读能丰富生活、开阔眼界。

words.note: enrich 由 en-（使）加 rich（富）构成，由“使富裕”引申为“丰富、充实”。

ex.en: The police foiled a plan to rob the bank.
ex.zh: 警方挫败了一起抢劫银行的计划。

words.note: foil 作动词指挫败计划或企图，作名词常见于 aluminium foil（铝箔）。

ex.en: The long working hours put a great strain on her health.
ex.zh: 长时间工作给她的健康带来很大压力。

words.note: strain 兼指拉伤、紧张与压力，put a strain on 是高频搭配。

ex.en: The two companies are negotiating a new contract.
ex.zh: 两家公司正在谈一份新合同。

words.note: negotiate 可直接接 deal，也可说 negotiate with sb。

ex.en: They stored the old wine in a cool cellar under the house.
ex.zh: 他们把陈酒存放在屋下阴凉的地窖里。

words.note: cellar 专指地下储藏室，尤指酒窖，与泛指房间的 basement 略有不同。

ex.en: The wires behind the desk were badly tangled.
ex.zh: 桌子后面的电线缠得乱七八糟。

words.note: tangle 常用 a tangle of（一团乱）与 get tangled up。

ex.en: The courier left a small package at the front desk.
ex.zh: 快递员在前台留下了一个小包裹。

words.note: 美式用 package 指包裹，英式多用 parcel。

ex.en: I was intrigued by the strange story she told me.
ex.zh: 她讲的离奇故事引起了我的浓厚兴趣。

words.note: intrigue 常用 be intrigued by，名词指阴谋。

ex.en: New students need time to orient themselves to campus life.
ex.zh: 新生需要时间适应校园生活。

words.note: orient 常用 orient oneself to，表示适应。

ex.en: The company is trying to survive the worst financial crisis in its history.
ex.zh: 公司正努力度过史上最严重的财务危机。

words.note: crisis 复数为 crises，常见 economic crisis。

ex.en: Poor eyesight is a serious handicap for a pilot.
ex.zh: 视力差对飞行员来说是很不利的条件。

words.note: handicap 作名词指障碍、不利条件，作动词常用 be handicapped by。

ex.en: The survival rate of these birds has fallen sharply in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来这类鸟的存活率急剧下降。

words.note: survival 来自 survive，常用 survival rate。

ex.en: The glass shattered into a thousand pieces on the floor.
ex.zh: 玻璃杯在地板上摔得粉碎。

words.note: shatter 强调突然碎成小块，也可喻指希望、信念破灭。

ex.en: The parents made an emotional plea for information about their missing son.
ex.zh: 这对父母动情地恳求提供失踪儿子的线索。

words.note: plea 指恳求，常用 make a plea for 表呼吁。

ex.en: It took a lot of persuasion to get him to change his mind.
ex.zh: 费了好一番劝说才让他改变主意。

words.note: persuasion 指说服的过程或能力，动词搭配为 persuade sb to do。

ex.en: She is keen on learning Japanese and practises every day.
ex.zh: 她热衷学日语，每天都练习。

words.note: be keen on 表热衷，a keen eye for 表眼光敏锐。

ex.en: Good nutrition is essential for children's growth and development.
ex.zh: 良好的营养对儿童生长发育至关重要。

words.note: nutrition 是名词营养，形容词为 nutritional。

ex.en: The detective examined every detail of the crime scene.
ex.zh: 侦探仔细查看了犯罪现场的每个细节。

words.note: detective 可作定语，如 detective story。

ex.en: He asked the bank to transfer the money to his new account.
ex.zh: 他请银行把钱转到他的新账户。

words.note: transfer 作动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

ex.en: The veteran journalist has covered wars for over twenty years.
ex.zh: 这位资深记者报道战争已二十多年。

words.note: veteran 作定语指经验丰富，如 veteran teacher；作名词指老兵、老手。

ex.en: He eats a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上吃一碗加牛奶的麦片。

words.note: cereal 既指谷类作物也指麦片，注意与同音的 serial（连续的）区分。

ex.en: The building was praised for its esthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 这栋建筑因审美吸引力而受到称赞。

words.note: esthetic 是 aesthetic 的美式拼法，常用作定语。

ex.en: He seemed indifferent to the criticism from his colleagues.
ex.zh: 他对同事的批评似乎毫不在意。

words.note: indifferent 意为“冷漠”，不是“无差别”。

ex.en: She has great affection for the village where she grew up.
ex.zh: 她对自己长大的村庄怀有很深的感情。

words.note: affection 指温和持久的喜爱，常接介词 for。

phr.zh: 制造转移注意力的举动

ex.en: A traffic diversion was set up while the bridge was repaired.
ex.zh: 修桥期间设置了交通绕行路线。

words.note: diversion 指改道或消遣，动词 divert 表示“转移、使改道”。

ex.en: My daughter started elementary school last September and loves it.
ex.zh: 我女儿去年九月上了小学，很喜欢那里。

words.note: elementary school 是美式“小学”，亦指基本的。

ex.en: The eagle circled high above the valley before diving for its prey.
ex.zh: 鹰在山谷上方盘旋，随后俯冲捕食。

words.note: eagle eye 指敏锐观察力，常与 keep 连用。

ex.en: He made a solemn promise never to lie to her again.
ex.zh: 他郑重承诺再也不对她撒谎。

words.note: solemn 强调庄重严肃，常与 promise、ceremony、vow 搭配。
